name: @orbb/smart
description: SMART-on-FHIR launch boundary for ORBB (M7-A A47): total, fail-closed parsing of EHR launch parameters (https iss with host, opaque launch handle, audience expectation — unknown parameters recorded as names only), a FROZEN read-shaped scope grammar (patient/<ResourceType>.rs over an allow-list of Patient/Observation/Condition/DocumentReference), deny-by-default scope evaluation plus launch/standing-grant intersection (a launch alone grants nothing — composition with the kernel access evaluation is required, never duplicated), the SmartTokenExchange seam with InMemoryTokenExchange and SynthEhrExchange SYNTH doubles (opaque tokens hashed at rest per the @orbb/auth discipline — never a JWT with embedded PHI), and an audit-record shape for every validation/exchange outcome (injected clock + id factory, iss host only). Zero network calls; zero external runtime dependencies (node:crypto + @orbb/testkit seams only). Real EHR integration is a recorded handoff, NOT shipped here.
